Title: Public preview: Azure Purview Bulk Edit enhancements

Body.Content:
Azure Purview now supports bulk editing of data assets to modify classifications as well as owners and experts. You can now select a list of data assets and add/replace/remove classifications or contacts to the list with a single action. As you search for data assets using Purview's search capability, you can add the data assets from search result page to pre-populate a list. You can also add data assets to the list by selecting the asset in asset details page. Once the list is ready, you can then review the list and then modify classifications, glossary terms, owners, and contacts for all the data assets in the list.

Learn more
